title: Portfolio Dashboard, Education Badges | Cornucopias
description:
Lots of new development: Portfolio Dashboard, Gamified Community Education, Web Site and MUCH MORE!

In this episode of COPI Cafe Josh and Rob announce a new hire, answer questions from the community and discuss our COPI stake pool. They also share exciting news about our portfolio dashboard that is already in the works, gamifying the education process within the community and the website redesign. The guys also discuss the upcoming events and the status of the racing game. They are also joined by Natalia, one of our very talented 3D Artists. And of course, the episode wouldn't be complete without a LEAK at the end.

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw 

00:00 - Intro 
02:14 - Beverage Choices
04:13 - COPI Stake Pool Update
05:56 - Portfolio Dashboard
06:50 - Gamifying Community Education
09:00 - New Hire
10:50 - Website Redesign
12:45 - cNFTcon
13:40 - Racing Game ported to UE5
15:23 - Special Guest - Natalia (3D Artist)
29:00 - Discord Community Questions
35:48 - LEAK

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK
